{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire inv_a, inv_b, cin;
    wire [63:0] x, y, p, g;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_result;
    wire [15:0] gp, gg, bc;
    wire [3:0] sp, sg, sc;

    assign inv_a = (Oper == 3'b010);
    assign inv_b = (Oper == 3'b001);
    assign cin = inv_a | inv_b;
    assign x = a ^ {64{inv_a}};
    assign y = b ^ {64{inv_b}};
    assign p = x ^ y;
    assign g = x & y;

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 16; n = n + 1) begin : bit_groups
            wire c1, c2, c3;
            assign gp[n] = &p[4*n +: 4];
            assign gg[n] = g[4*n+3]
                         | (p[4*n+3] & g[4*n+2])
                         | (p[4*n+3] & p[4*n+2] & g[4*n+1])
                         | (p[4*n+3] & p[4*n+2] & p[4*n+1] & g[4*n]);
            assign c1 = g[4*n] | (p[4*n] & bc[n]);
            assign c2 = g[4*n+1]
                      | (p[4*n+1] & g[4*n])
                      | (p[4*n+1] & p[4*n] & bc[n]);
            assign c3 = g[4*n+2]
                      | (p[4*n+2] & g[4*n+1])
                      | (p[4*n+2] & p[4*n+1] & g[4*n])
                      | (p[4*n+2] & p[4*n+1] & p[4*n] & bc[n]);
            assign arithmetic_result[4*n +: 4] =
                p[4*n +: 4] ^ {c3, c2, c1, bc[n]};
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 4; n = n + 1) begin : group_groups
            assign sp[n] = &gp[4*n +: 4];
            assign sg[n] = gg[4*n+3]
                         | (gp[4*n+3] & gg[4*n+2])
                         | (gp[4*n+3] & gp[4*n+2] & gg[4*n+1])
                         | (gp[4*n+3] & gp[4*n+2] & gp[4*n+1] & gg[4*n]);
            assign bc[4*n] = sc[n];
            assign bc[4*n+1] = gg[4*n] | (gp[4*n] & sc[n]);
            assign bc[4*n+2] = gg[4*n+1]
                            | (gp[4*n+1] & gg[4*n])
                            | (gp[4*n+1] & gp[4*n] & sc[n]);
            assign bc[4*n+3] = gg[4*n+2]
                            | (gp[4*n+2] & gg[4*n+1])
                            | (gp[4*n+2] & gp[4*n+1] & gg[4*n])
                            | (gp[4*n+2] & gp[4*n+1] & gp[4*n] & sc[n]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign sc[0] = cin;
    assign sc[1] = sg[0] | (sp[0] & cin);
    assign sc[2] = sg[1]
                 | (sp[1] & sg[0])
                 | (sp[1] & sp[0] & cin);
    assign sc[3] = sg[2]
                 | (sp[2] & sg[1])
                 | (sp[2] & sp[1] & sg[0])
                 | (sp[2] & sp[1] & sp[0] & cin);

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b001: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b010: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse long arithmetic carry logic and final operation selection, reaching upper result bits from low input bits.",
  "rewrite": "Share one arithmetic datapath across addition and both subtraction directions. Conditional operand inversion implements a+b, a+~b+1, or ~a+b+1. Explicit four-bit carry lookahead, sixteen-bit group lookahead, and top-level lookahead replace a long carry dependency. Keep the original operation decoding and default-zero result.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded hierarchical carry network is intended to reduce the 3.05 ns baseline arrival. No mapped candidate results are available, so a numerical gain, timing improvement, or electrical-clean result cannot be asserted without running the specified flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing the arithmetic datapath should reduce duplication relative to three separate arithmetic expressions. Explicit lookahead adds group generate/propagate logic and conditional-inversion fanout. Mapped area and compliance with the 13098.437440 um^2 cap require measurement.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface, unsigned 64-bit operands, combinational behavior, all seven defined operations, and zero for Oper=111. Arithmetic results are modulo 2^64, matching the original observable sum truncation. The original c_out is internal and unobservable; its discarded carry or borrow is not computed. No storage, clocks, latency, assumptions, external dependencies, or input restrictions are introduced. Equivalence and electrical checks must still be run."
}
